notes: WhaleChat 3.60.0 — Brevo email is connected end to end (API key, SMTP relay and the Cloudflare edge sender), so signup verification codes actually arrive. Code verification is now forgiving in the right direction: a correct code always verifies the account — leading zeros, spaces, dashes, pasted text, a resend or an already-verified account can never make a valid code fail. Version 3.56.0 accounts jane and investorD can be restored with the new restore script.
